items.title: Gurde ke kaam ka hormonal qaboo (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the hormonal control of kidney functions (PDF 17-18).

blocks.text: Jab jism ko pani bachana ho to gurde hypertonic (gaarha) peshab nikalte hain. Jab jism mein pani zyada ho to gurde hypotonic (patla) peshab nikalte hain. Gurdon ke yeh kaam neeche diye gaye hormones qaboo (coordinate) karte hain.
ADH pani bachane ke liye jism ka sab se aham zariya hai. Yeh hypothalamus mein banta hai aur posterior pituitary gland ise khoon mein chhorta (secrete karta) hai.

Jab jism mein pani ki kami (dehydration) ho ya namkeen khana khaya gaya ho to khoon mein namak ki zyada miqdar ko hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors (namak ki miqdar mehsoos karne wale receptors) pakar lete hain. Hypothalamus khud pyaas ka ehsas paida karta hai aur posterior pituitary ko ADH chhorne ka signal deta hai. ADH collecting ducts ki deewaron par asar karta hai aur unhen pani ke liye zyada permeable (pani guzarne wali) bana deta hai. Is liye zyada pani filtrate se nikal kar gird ke hypertonic (namkeen) mayi mein aur phir khoon mein chala jata hai. Is tarah gaarha peshab banta hai aur pani bach jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke hypothalamus posterior pituitary ko pyaas ka ehsas paida karne ka signal deta hai. Pyaas posterior pituitary paida nahin karta; pyaas ka ehsas hypothalamus ka apna thirst centre paida karta hai. Posterior pituitary sirf ADH chhorta hai.

Jab khoon mein namak ki miqdar kam ho jaye to hypothalamus ADH ka ikhraj rok deta hai. Collecting duct ki deewarein pani ke liye kam permeable ho jati hain. Is liye kam pani wapas liya jata hai aur patla peshab nikalta hai. Natije mein khoon ki miqdar (blood volume) aur blood pressure kam ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: ADH khoon ki miqdar (blood volume) barhata hai, jis se blood pressure barhta hai. ADH khoon ki nalyon ko sukarta (tang karta) bhi hai, aur is se blood pressure aur barh jata hai.

Jo shakhs pituitary gland ke nuqsan ki wajah se kaafi ADH nahin bana sakta, woh lagataar bohat zyada patla peshab karta hai. Is bimari ko diabetes insipidus kehte hain. Aise shakhs ko jism mein pani ki shadeed kami (dehydration) aur bohat kam blood pressure ka khatra hota hai.

Aldosterone woh hormone hai jo peshab mein sodium aur potassium ki miqdar qaboo karta hai. Yeh adrenal cortex mein banta hai (adrenal cortex adrenal gland ki bahar wali tah hai; adrenal gland gurde ke upar hota hai).

Aldosterone tab nikalta hai jab blood pressure gir jaye ya khoon mein sodium bohat kam ho. Yeh distal convoluted tubule aur collecting duct ki deewaron par asar karta hai aur filtrate se sodium ions ko khoon mein wapas lene (reabsorption) ko barhata hai. Khoon mein sodium ions zyada hone ki wajah se pani bhi filtrate se khoon mein chala jata hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Aldosterone peshab mein potassium ions ke ikhraj ko bhi barhata hai. Is se hyperkalaemia se bachao hota hai; hyperkalaemia mein khoon mein potassium bohat zyada ho jata hai aur dil ki dharkan be-tarteeb (cardiac arrhythmias) ho sakti hai, jo khatarnak hai.
Gurde mein capillaries ke do bistar (Two capillary beds)
Gurde mein capillaries ke do alag bistar (capillary beds) ek ke baad ek kaam kar ke khoon ko process karte hain.

items: Glomerular capillaries Bowman's capsule ke andar hoti hain. Yeh filtration (chhanne) ke liye bani hain. Yeh zyada blood pressure par kaam karti hain jo pani aur chhote ghule madde khoon se nikal kar nephron mein dhakel deta hai.

Peritubular capillaries renal tubules ke gird hoti hain. In ka bara kaam reabsorption aur secretion hai. Yeh kam hydrostatic pressure (mayi ka dabao) par kaam karti hain aur zaroori ghizai madde (glucose, ions) aur pani tubules se wapas khoon mein kheench leti hain. Yeh kuch khaas zehreele madde tubule mein secrete bhi karti hain.

blocks.title: Number ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab is hisse ka number 14.1.2 chhapti hai, lekin yeh 14.2 (peshab ke gaarhepan ka qaboo) ka hissa hai, yaani is ka number 14.2.2 hona chahiye tha.

blocks.prompt: Kaunse do tareeqe gurde ko peshab ki gaarhapan badalne dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Counter-current mechanism, jo loop of Henle aur collecting duct ke gird namak ki zyada miqdar rakhta hai, aur ADH aur aldosterone ke zariye hormonal qaboo.

blocks.prompt: Aik shakhs ne bohat namkeen khana khaya. ADH peshab ko kaise badalta hai, qadam ba qadam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors khoon mein zyada namak pakarte hain; pyaas lagti aur posterior pituitary ADH chhorta hai; collecting ducts pani ke liye zyada permeable hoti hain; zyada pani namkeen medulla aur khoon mein jata hai; thora sa gaarha peshab banta hai.

items: Peshab ka gaarhapan do tareeqon se qaboo hota hai: counter-current mechanism aur hormones (ADH, aldosterone).
ADH (hypothalamus mein banta, posterior pituitary chhorta): collecting duct zyada permeable, gaarha peshab, pani bachta hai; ADH ki kami se diabetes insipidus.
Aldosterone (adrenal cortex): DCT aur collecting duct mein Na⁺ wapas, saath pani bhi; K⁺ peshab mein nikalta hai.
Glomerular capillaries zyada dabao par filtration; peritubular capillaries kam dabao par reabsorption aur secretion.
